summary: Dark brown, crumbly topsoil, the ground of a garden bed or a forest path.
_comment: Loam: a dark brown, crumbly topsoil, the ground of a garden bed or a forest path (ambientCG Ground048, CC0; tagged soil, dirt, ground; 140 x 140 cm), quilted into an exact 1 m tile (tools/converters/base/quilt_scan.py, 2026-10-22, Phase19 D-9): every patch at the scan's own size, nothing stretched. Opaque: soil is a matte, rough solid at any viewing distance. The source says soil, not loam (loam is a soil texture class); the name keeps the wish list's word for an ordinary garden topsoil. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): cracks (overlay 1, damage; Cracks01 draws a dried-mud network, the right shape for soil), pitting (overlay 2, rain-pocked or crumbled ground), gated by the Patches mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
